approach: Add one gate-crate helper, `attribution::after_cutover(git, commit) -> Result<Option<String>>`. It returns C0 only when the commit's athena.toml names a cutover_job, `cutover_state` is Shown, and C0 is the commit or its ancestor. Otherwise it returns None, so an unset cutover_job, a missing landing record, or Pending keeps today's behaviour. Use it in three places. (1) Writing: `Committer::build_commit_in` (commits.rs) and `commit_with_staged` (manage.rs) strip `Athena-*` trailer lines from the last paragraph when the parent is at or after C0. (2) Gating: `gate()` skips only `invariant::check` for changes whose first parent is at or after C0, matching `check_history`, which already judges post-C0 commits by records. (3) Reading: trailer readers keep their grep path for commits up to C0 and add a records/path fallback limited to `C0..head`. The squash-text check relaxes only once C0 is shown. Scope: the request's Files line names whole crates (athena-core, athena-gate, athena-cli), so gate/lib.rs, manage.rs and run.rs are inside it. The extra files are touched only where tracing shows a trailer dependency, and the producer must leave run.rs and land.rs untouched if no change is needed there.

decisions.choice: Strip Athena- trailers once, in the commit-writing functions, keyed on the parent's cutover state.
decisions.reason: All Athena plumbing commits pass through Committer::build_commit_in, and staged interventions go through commit_with_staged. One filter covers about 40 message(..., trailers) call sites and makes 'before C0 shows, trailers still written' a single check.

rejected.option: Edit every call site to omit trailers
rejected.why: About 40 edits across many files; easy to miss one and the C0 test would repeat in each.
message() is pure, has no git or cutover knowledge, and pre-C0 callers need trailers.

decisions.choice: Decide 'after C0' from the parent commit: config at the parent, cutover_state Shown, C0 equals or is an ancestor of the parent.
decisions.reason: Same condition check_history uses. C0 itself keeps trailers; the next commit is the first without. Unset, no landing, or Pending gives None, so criterion 4 holds.

rejected.option: Read the local checkout's athena.toml or a global flag
rejected.why: The checkout can lack the setting; the commit's own config is the source of truth.

decisions.choice: Gate skips only invariant::check for post-C0 changes.
decisions.reason: Without trailers, names_existing_work refuses records-only commits. D111 judges post-C0 commits by attribution against records. Secrets, content and jobs checks stay.

rejected.why: Athena's own trailer-less commits would be refused.

decisions.choice: Readers keep the trailer path and add a C0..head records/path fallback; squash text relaxes only when C0 is shown.
decisions.reason: Deleting trailer reading is out of scope and criterion 3 needs unchanged results up to C0; a union with grep results first cannot change them.

rejected.option: Switch all readers to record-based lookup
rejected.why: Changes pre-C0 behaviour and drops trailer reading.

steps: Read athena-gate legacy.rs, records_import.rs and the history.rs test helpers to see how a shown cutover is built in a scratch repository.
Add attribution::after_cutover with unit tests (None cases and a Some case).
In gate() (athena-gate lib.rs), skip invariant::check when after_cutover is Some for the first parent; test a trailer-less records-only commit passes after C0 and fails before.

risks.risk: A wrong cutover decision strips trailers too early and breaks pre-C0 repositories.
risks.mitigation: after_cutover unit tests for each None case (no cutover_job, no records branch, Pending, manifest naming another commit); existing suite unchanged and green.

risks.risk: The filter removes text that is not a trailer.
risks.mitigation: Strip only the last paragraph and only keys with the Athena- prefix; test a body with an 'Athena-' line mid-text; Co-Authored-By kept.

risks.risk: The fallback changes results for pre-C0 jobs.
risks.mitigation: Range is C0..head; grep results come first and are deduplicated; test equality with the old output.

risks.risk: landed_commit picks the wrong commit for a post-C0 job.
risks.mitigation: Content-based match on the commit that added the job's outcome-landed.json; test that two jobs are not confused.

risks.risk: Skipping invariant::check weakens the commit-time check.
risks.mitigation: Skip only that check after C0; secrets, content and jobs checks stay; check_history and attribution judge afterwards.
No new dependency; files beyond the brief's list are inside the request's named crates and touched only where a trailer dependency is confirmed.

demonstrations.method: Scratch-repository test in lifecycle.rs: build a shown cutover (cutover job landed, landing record, import manifest, legacy-exempt on athena/records), then make a landing, a declared intervention and a records-only commit, writing the landing records that attribute them.
demonstrations.observes: For each of the three commits, parsed trailers contain no key starting 'Athena-', and the records branch holds a landing record whose host_commit is each commit.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the strip in build_commit_in/commit_with_staged the messages keep Athena-Job/Intervention/Record lines and the no-Athena- assertion fails; without the gate skip the trailer-less records-only commit is refused.

demonstrations.method: Same test runs check_history(git, "HEAD") and check_attribution_with_legacy (the functions behind athena check --history and --attribution) on the post-C0 commits.
demonstrations.observes: Both reports have no violations or findings after the three commits.
demonstrations.fails_without: If post-C0 commits were still judged by trailers or records did not attribute them, the reports would list unattributed or trailer violations and the empty-violations assertion fails.

demonstrations.method: Unit tests in status.rs and auditor.rs build trailer-bearing commits up to C0 with a shown cutover; call trace and read_changed_files for a pre-C0 job and a post-C0 job. A test in athena-git checks squash_text stays strict.
demonstrations.observes: Pre-C0 job results come through trailers and equal the results with no cutover configured; the post-C0 job is found by the fallback; strict squash_text still refuses zero or two Athena-Job trailers.
demonstrations.fails_without: If readers lost the trailer path, trace would list no commits and read_changed_files would fail for a pre-C0 job.

demonstrations.method: Unit tests for after_cutover and the message filter cover: no cutover_job, cutover_job with no landing record, and landing without manifest (Pending). The full existing suite runs unedited.
demonstrations.observes: In those cases after_cutover is None and Committer commits keep their Athena- trailers; all existing tests pass without edits.
demonstrations.fails_without: If after_cutover returned Some in those cases, the new commits.rs tests find stripped trailers and existing tests such as a_request_lands_a_traceable_commit (asserts Athena-Job) fail.

demonstrations.method: A content test reads CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md for the new text; git diff also shows it.
demonstrations.observes: Both files mention D111 and job 7 part 1b, say trailers stop after C0, and name the readers that keep trailers up to C0 (status trace, audit file lookup, landed-commit lookup, strict squash check).
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the new text the test's contains checks fail.

demonstrations.method: Run the three Athena checks together.
demonstrations.command: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked
demonstrations.observes: fmt reports no diff, clippy no warnings, and all tests pass including the new ones.
demonstrations.fails_without: Unformatted code fails fmt; any warning fails clippy; and if the post-C0 behaviour were missing, the new lifecycle, commits.rs, reader and gate tests in the suite fail, so cargo test fails.

demonstrations.observes: Changed paths are only crates' .rs files, CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md; athena.toml, defaults.toml and .github workflows are absent.
demonstrations.fails_without: If a governance file were edited it would appear in git status and the check fails.
